channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 7:45 AM, 19 November 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Quezon (Quezon, Alabat, Calauag, Perez, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Atimonan, Mauban, Plaridel, Gumaca, Lopez, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Infanta, Real, and General Nakar) within the next 3 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 18 November 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Tanauan, Talisay, Balete, Lipa, Malvar, Santo Tomas, Mataasnakahoy, and Padre Garcia), Bulacan (Norzagaray and Dona Remedios Trinidad), Laguna (Pangil, Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Calamba, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Kalayaan, Lumban, Paete, and Pakil), Quezon (Infanta, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Mauban, Real, Sampaloc, Lucban, Tayabas, Lucena, Pagbilao, Atimonan, Sariaya, Candelaria, Dolores, Tiaong, San Antonio, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Calauag, Tagkawayan, and Guinayangan), and Rizal (Rodriguez, Antipolo, Teresa, Baras, Cardona, Jala-Jala, Morong, and Pililla) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Laguna (Santa Maria, Famy, Mabitac, and Siniloan), Quezon (General Nakar, Panukulan, Burdeos, and Polillo), and Rizal (Tanay) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
